We need to make a small mid-cycle change to our Redwood plan. Effective 2026-09-15 we want to: 
- Reduce active developer seats by 8 (from 42 -> 34)
- Add the GPU Burst add-on (1x) for the remainder of the month

Can you confirm how this will be reflected on the invoice? We need a single document that shows:
1) credit for the 8 removed seats pro-rated to 9/15,
2) charge for the GPU Burst add-on pro-rated to 9/15,
3) the net amount for this partial-period adjustment, and
4) VAT treatment — we are an EU entity and our VAT ID is ESB12345678. If this qualifies for reverse-charge, please issue the invoice net of VAT and include the reverse-charge note.

Also please confirm whether you need a PO for this change (we can provide BH-PO-778). Billing contact is accounting@brightharbor.com.

Thanks,

Hi Maria / team,

Thanks — I've drafted a provisional pro-forma and a credit memo for the change effective 2026-09-15. Attached are two stubs: BH_proforma_20260912.pdf and credit-memo-provisional-9421.pdf. (Final invoice will reference the credit memo if you opt to combine.)

Provisional calculations (EUR):
- Seat credit: 8 seats 
  - Monthly seat rate: €180.00 per seat
  - Pro-rate days: 16/30 (change effective 15th, we bill remainder, credit for unused portion)
  - Credit = 8 * €180.00 * (16/30) = €768.00 (credit)

- GPU Burst add-on: 1 unit
  - Monthly add-on rate: €3,600.00
  - Pro-rate days: 16/30
  - Charge = €3,600.00 * (16/30) = €1,920.00 (charge)

Net adjustment = Charge (€1,920.00) - Credit (€768.00) = €1,152.00 (net due for remainder of September)

VAT treatment: I validated the VAT ID ESB12345678 against the EU VIES lookup and it returns valid. We will apply reverse-charge. Final invoice will show 0% VAT and include the standard EU reverse-charge note: "VAT reversed under Article 196 of Council Directive 2006/112/EC; customer liable for VAT in their member state."

The provisional documents include the line items and an explanatory note. Please confirm:
- Confirm PO: BH-PO-778 (we will include on final invoice)
- Billing method: SEPA transfer (please confirm IBAN to send payment instructions), or card on file?
- Billing contact: accounting@brightharbor.com

Once you confirm PO and payment method I'll generate a final invoice (final invoice will be dated 2026-09-15, due in 30 days by default).

Attachments: 
- BH_proforma_20260912.pdf (PDF)
- credit-memo-provisional-9421.pdf (PDF)

Regards,
Laura Bennett
